landing.title: A marketplace for debt collection
landing.subtitle: Connect creditors with licensed collection agencies and recover what you're owed, faster.

creditor.step1: Submit your case and sign online
creditor.step2: Licensed agencies compete for your case

fee.title: Simple, success-based pricing
fee.subtitle: No recovery, no fee — creditors only pay a platform fee out of what is actually recovered.
fee.noCurePay: No-cure, no-pay: if an agency does not recover anything, you owe nothing.
fee.band1: Smaller claims carry a higher platform percentage to keep agency economics viable.
fee.band2: Mid-sized claims settle at a moderate platform percentage, balanced against expected recovery.
fee.band3: Larger claims benefit from the lowest platform percentage, reflecting economies of scale.
fee.disclaimer: Exact bands and rates are configured per country and may change; see your case for the rate that applies.

trust.title: Built for trust and compliance
trust.qesBody: Mandates and award contracts are signed with eIDAS-qualified electronic signatures (QES), giving them the same legal weight as a handwritten signature.
trust.gdprBody: Personal data is processed under documented legal bases, retained only as long as necessary, and subject to full data-subject rights.
trust.vettedBody: Every agency is checked for collection licences and jurisdiction coverage before it can bid on a case.
trust.redactionBody: Debtor identifying details are redacted from listings until a case is awarded, so agencies bid on the facts, not the person.

footer.sandboxDisclaimer: This is a sandbox environment. Signatures, payments, and identity checks use simulated providers — no real money or legal documents are processed.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how we process personal data on this platform. It is a placeholder pending final review by counsel and will be updated before general availability.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: [To be confirmed by counsel: legal entity name, registered address, registration number, and contact details of the data controller.]

purposes.title: Purposes of processing
purposes.body: We process personal data to operate the marketplace: creating accounts and organizations, verifying identity (KYC), submitting and managing collection cases, matching cases with collection agencies, processing signatures and payments, communicating with debtors, and handling disputes and support requests.

legalBases.title: Legal bases
legalBases.body: Processing relies on: performance of a contract with you (account and case management), legitimate interest (marketplace matching, fraud prevention, service improvement), legal obligation (KYC/AML, accounting, retention), and consent where specifically requested.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.body: Collection agencies that are awarded a case receive the case and debtor data necessary to perform the collection mandate. Agencies act as separate data controllers (or processors, depending on the mandate) for that data — the precise allocation of controller/processor roles is [to be confirmed by counsel]. We also share data with signature and payment service providers, and with authorities where legally required.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Case and financial records are retained for as long as the case is active and for 3 years after closure for legal and accounting purposes, after which debtor personal data is anonymized. You may request erasure earlier where no legal hold applies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, and port your personal data, and to object to certain processing. Contact us using the details below to exercise these rights.

complaints.title: Right to complain
complaints.body: If you believe your data has been processed unlawfully, you may lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority: in the Czech Republic, the Office for Personal Data Protection (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, ÚOOÚ, www.uoou.cz); in Slovakia, the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic (Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov SR, ÚOOÚ SR, www.dataprotection.gov.sk).

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: [To be confirmed by counsel: contact email/address for data protection enquiries and, if applicable, the Data Protection Officer.]

payment_reminder.subject: Payment reminder — {caseReference}
payment_reminder.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We would like to kindly remind you of the outstanding amount of {amount} owed to {creditorName} under case {caseReference}. We would be grateful if you could settle this amount at your earliest convenience, or contact us to arrange a suitable payment plan.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Kind regards

final_notice.subject: Final notice — {caseReference}
final_notice.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is a final notice regarding the outstanding amount of {amount} owed to {creditorName} under case {caseReference}. Should payment not be received within the stated period, we may be obliged to pursue further collection measures, including legal action.

We encourage you to settle the amount promptly or to contact us without delay.

Kind regards
